summary: #3103 (section 5). DrawSync; walks the current screen OT (after screen_compact_ot) up to the last entry's terminator word (*0x800756d0); every POLY_FT4 (code & 0xfc == 0x2c) whose corners form an axis-aligned rectangle (x0-x1 == x2-x3, y0-y2 == y1-y3) and whose centre is within half its size of the 320x240 screen is blended into the 24-bit movie frame in VRAM at (0x801ecba0 + x*3/2, 0x801ecb86 + y): texture StoreImage'd (width (du+3)>>2 / (du+1)/2 / du halfwords by depth), CLUT to the scratchpad (depth 1 non-raw: entries rewritten (r modulated)>>3 | (c&0xf7)<<2 | (c&0xf7)<<7). Scaled quads: depth 0 only, nearest texel (col*du/dx + (min_u&3)), copy or (semi) abr 2 subtract. Write back with LoadImage; a quad with min_x outside 0..0x13f is clipped to 0x13f-x and every row lands on its top row (bug: row never added to y)
